review.decision: Use the active local workspace for every preview entry.
review.notes: Publishing the immutable App reference must still succeed offline. Generate a local browser address only from an identifiable running workspace. Verify a fresh private serve status against its live loopback boot identity without sending a credential. Bind families determine the literal loopback host. An explicit port must agree with the verified endpoint. The packaged-host fixture will run a private nondefault workspace.

cases.description: Local preview follows the running workspace port and refuses an unavailable endpoint
cases.setup: Synthetic private serve status, random loopback listener, disposable artifact store and an injected opener. Check default-port address selection without binding the developer's default port.
cases.action: Generate a registration receipt and open command URL, including an explicit port. Test IPv4 and IPv6 bind selection, absent or stale status, closed listener, wrong boot, malformed response and mismatched port.
cases.expected: Only a verified local service yields an HTTP address. The published App reference survives unavailable service and the CLI reports how to retry. An explicit port cannot send a credential or select a foreign host.
